items.title: Late SOX compliance filing resulted in SEC enforcement
items.description: A mid-cap company missed the SOX Section 404 filing deadline by 15 days. The SEC issued an enforcement action and the company's stock dropped 8% on the news. Root cause was inadequate internal controls documentation.
items.recommendation: Begin SOX compliance documentation at least 90 days before filing deadline. Assign dedicated compliance officer to track progress.

items.title: AML gaps led to $50M regulatory fine
items.description: A financial institution's AML monitoring system failed to flag suspicious transactions from shell companies. The regulator found 2,300 unreported suspicious activities over 18 months.
items.recommendation: Conduct quarterly reviews of AML transaction monitoring rules. Test with known suspicious patterns.

items.title: Material weakness in revenue recognition went undetected
items.description: An auditor missed a material weakness in revenue recognition policies. The company was recording multi-year contracts at signing instead of over the contract term. Restatement required for 3 fiscal years.
items.recommendation: Review revenue recognition policies against ASC 606 requirements. Test sample of contracts for proper timing of recognition.

items.title: GDPR breach from insufficient data mapping
items.description: A financial services firm received a GDPR fine for failing to identify all systems storing personal data. Customer complaint revealed PII in a legacy analytics database not covered by the data protection impact assessment.
items.recommendation: Maintain a comprehensive data inventory. Include legacy and analytical systems in data protection assessments.
